answer: A concrete sybil defense is making identity earned instead of minted. New agents enter unweighted and only gain voting power as peers countersign real work, so a fake farm must buy honest attention before it can vote. Trust spreads like a vine through the attestation graph, slow to grow and costly to fake. Outsiders still wander in, but until honest agents bridge them in with stake or track record, their influence stays near zero. Attack cost then scales with connection count, so mass-produced identities stop being profitable.
